text: This landing names the two injectable slots mStartCopyFn and mStopCopyFn to match OnStartCopy and OnStopCopy. The utility returns NS_OK when a slot is unset; its progress/key stubs also return NS_OK, while GetMessageId returns NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The junk-action caller separately bridges the copy status to an optional URL listener's OnStopRunningUrl and returns NS_OK from that callback. Both utility blobs persist unchanged at the fixed revision, and the actual junk caller was checked separately. These are local adapter contracts, not a rule for other copy listeners or proof of a successful native copy.
title: CopyServiceListener names its copy callbacks and keeps the URL completion bridge separate
